overviewParagraphs: Hoiana Shores Golf Club stands as one of the most significant golf openings in Southeast Asia in recent years. Designed by the legendary Robert Trent Jones Jr., it is the first course in Vietnam to sit directly on the East Sea, delivering a true links experience in a tropical setting.

The 18-hole layout winds through natural coastal dunes near the UNESCO World Heritage site of Hoi An, offering spectacular panoramic ocean views from nearly every hole. The course demands respect for the wind, rewarding players who think their way around rather than overpower it.

Part of the prestigious Hoiana integrated resort, the club features world-class clubhouse facilities, a luxury pro-shop, and a strategic practice facility. For discerning golfers seeking the authentic links challenge in an exotic location, Hoiana Shores is unmissable.
curatorBriefHtml: Hoiana Shores Golf Club (opened 2019 south of Hoi An) is Vietnam’s #1 championship golf experience — a true Robert Trent Jones Jr. coastal links sculpted across raw East Sea sand dunes. Playing 6,554 yards from the Blue Tees (7,004 yards from the Championship tips, Par 71), the front nine winds inland through rolling dune ridges before the unforgettable closing stretch (holes 14–18) emerges directly onto the ocean shoreline.

Having played Hoiana Shores personally, the single biggest tactical tip is respecting the East Sea wind and embracing the ground game. Zeon Zoysia fairways and firm TifEagle Bermuda runoff aprons reward low bump-and-run pitches and putts from well off the green — especially on the dramatic par-4 16th and the wind-whipped beachfront par-3 17th. Always book a 07:30–08:30 AM tee time before afternoon sea winds climb past 18 knots.

Sitting just 15–20 minutes south of Hoi An / An Bang Beach (with New World Hoiana on-site), Hoiana Shores anchors our flagship Central Coast Classic. Dive deeper in our Hoiana Shores Review & Green Fees or compare it in Hoiana Shores vs. Laguna Lang Co.

scorecard.verdict: A tour-de-force in modern links architecture. Robert Trent Jones Jr. sculpted a layout that directly hugs the East Sea dunes, demanding creative ground-game imagination in shifting afternoon sea breezes. Indisputably one of the top championship golf experiences in Asia.

faqs.q: What are the current green fees at Hoiana Shores Golf Club?
faqs.a: Green fees at Hoiana Shores are approximately $300 USD (7,500,000 VND) per 18-hole round including dedicated 1-on-1 caddie and shared motorized cart (excluding the customary $20–$30 USD caddie tip). AGS bundles confirmed Hoiana Shores tee times and private transfers directly into bespoke itineraries.

faqs.q: Why should we book an early morning tee time at Hoiana Shores?
faqs.a: Coastal breezes off the East Sea typically build from 11:30 AM onward, turning the exposed shoreline closing stretch (holes 14–18) into a fierce 18–22 knot links test. Early 07:30–08:30 AM starts give the smoothest greens and calmer conditions.

faqs.q: How far is Hoiana Shores from Hoi An and Da Nang International Airport?
faqs.a: Hoiana Shores is 15–20 minutes south of Hoi An and our An Bang Beach villa portfolio, and 40–45 minutes south of Da Nang International Airport (DAD) by private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: Is Hoiana Shores playable for mid-to-high handicap golfers?
faqs.a: Yes. While the back tips stretch to 7,004 yards, playing the Blue Tees (6,554 yards) or White Tees (~6,000 yards) opens up generous fairway corridors with zero forced jungle carries — just keep the ball low out of the wind.
